records.name: La Moutonne
records.notes: INAO describes La Moutonne as a historic usage name, approximately 95% within Vaudésir and 5% within Preuses. It is not one of the seven official climat names enumerated in the current specification and therefore remains fail-closed for the ordinary official-climat claim path.
